name: io.github.VaitaR/aiochainscan
title: aiochainscan
description: Read-only blockchain data: balances, transactions, tokens, holders, contract ABIs, ENS.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: The MCP server ships in the mcp extra of the aiochainscan distribution.

environmentVariables.name: ETHERSCAN_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Etherscan v2 API key. Optional: without it the server uses the keyless BlockScout scanner, which covers fewer methods.

environmentVariables.name: NODEREAL_KEY
environmentVariables.description: NodeReal API key, used only for BSC chains.

environmentVariables.name: AIOCHAINSCAN_MCP_SCANNER
environmentVariables.description: Default scanner for tools that do not pass one: blockscout, blockscout_v2, etherscan or nodereal.
